en: Revenue rose 21% to $16.5B, in line with the ~$16.5B consensus, and non-GAAP EPS of $0.52 beat $0.40 as gross margin reached 44.1%, two points above guide. Data Center and AI grew 78% to $7.3B, its best in 15 years, while PC chips fell 5% on the memory shortage. The Q4 guide of $15.5B and $0.25 EPS fell well short of about $17.1B and $0.43. CEO Lip-Bu Tan said supply, not demand, limits servers; CFO David Zinsner expects PC softness through H1 2027 and no positive cash flow in 2026.

Shares closed at $92.07 before the report, already 35% below the June high, and fell about 23% after hours. On Oct 30 they plunged 28.6% to $65.76, Intel's worst day since 1974, erasing roughly $140B of market value. The Q4 guide drove it: Intel now sees PC shipments down about 12% this year and 10% in 2027 as memory costs bite, plus the Israel fab outage. BofA and Roth cut to Neutral, Bernstein called the outlook terrible, and the SOX fell 7.2%.
zh: 营收增长 21% 至 165 亿美元，与约 165 亿美元的预期持平；非 GAAP 每股收益 0.52 美元，高于 0.40 美元预期，毛利率 44.1%，比指引高 2 个百分点。数据中心与 AI 业务增长 78% 至 73 亿美元，为 15 年来最佳，PC 芯片则因内存短缺下滑 5%。第四季指引营收 155 亿美元、每股收益 0.25 美元，远低于约 171 亿美元和 0.43 美元的预期。CEO 陈立武称服务器受限于供应而非需求；CFO 津斯纳预计 PC 疲软持续至 2027 年上半年，2026 年现金流不会为正。

财报前收盘价为 92.07 美元，已较 6 月高点低 35%，盘后下跌约 23%。10 月 30 日暴跌 28.6% 至 65.76 美元，为 1974 年以来最大单日跌幅，市值蒸发约 1,400 亿美元。第四季指引是主因：受内存成本推高影响，英特尔预计今年 PC 出货量下滑约 12%、2027 年再降约 10%，叠加以色列晶圆厂停产。美银和 Roth 将评级下调至中性，Bernstein 称展望“糟糕”，费城半导体指数下跌 7.2%。

bio.en: Founded venture firm Walden International in 1987 and was CEO of Cadence Design Systems from 2009 to 2021, reviving its growth and margins. Joined Intel's board in 2022, left in 2024, and returned as CEO in March 2025 to fix manufacturing and win foundry customers.
bio.zh: 1987 年创立创投公司华登国际，2009–2021 年任 Cadence CEO，带动其增长与利润率回升。2022 年加入英特尔董事会，2024 年离任，2025 年 3 月回归出任 CEO，致力改善制造并争取代工客户。

bio.en: CFO since January 2022 and co-interim CEO from December 2024 to March 2025. Previously CFO of Micron, and earlier president and COO of Affirmed Networks and CFO of Analog Devices.
bio.zh: 2022 年 1 月起任 CFO，2024 年 12 月至 2025 年 3 月曾任联席临时 CEO。此前任美光 CFO，更早担任 Affirmed Networks 总裁兼 COO 及亚德诺（ADI）CFO。
